description: DeepSeek official desktop client for the Harness agent runtime, supporting background tasks, local file access and plugin management.
notes: DeepSeek Harness official desktop app (Electron NSIS installer, 64-bit).
Two-layer extraction: Scoop 7z-extracts the NSIS installer, then the inner $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z is expanded, which contains 'DeepSeek Harness.exe'.
The Windows download URL is versionless (dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe); Scoop autoupdate recomputes the SHA-256 by downloading the new installer, so updates may take a while.
Version is sourced from the deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness GitHub releases, which mirror the desktop client releases.
